# Haticons

> A set of 494 beautifully crafted, modular, lightweight Webfont and SVG Icons for Web, iOS, Android, and Desktop apps.
> An open-source project by PebbleBenders, built with first-class support for boodoo Framework.

- Website: https://haticons.com
- Documentation / Tutorial: https://haticons.com/tutorial.html
- Full Icon Reference: https://haticons.com/reference.html
- Changelog: https://haticons.com/changelogs.html
- npm Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/haticons
- Repository: https://github.com/prashmaybe/haticons

## Key Architecture & Features
- 494 crisp vector icons categorized into 14 distinct modules (Brands, UI & Interface, Commerce, Directional, Media, Editor, Feedback, Files, Devices, Communication, Users, Navigation, Security, Time).
- Zero-waste modular CSS: users do not need to import the full bundle. They can load individual categories (e.g., `dist/css/categories/commerce.min.css`) or pure category glyphs (`commerce-only.min.css`) along with `core.min.css`.
- Full Sass / SCSS support with configurable variables (`$hi-font-path`, `$hi-prefix`) and category partials in `scss/categories/`.
- First-class UI styling designed with boodoo CSS Framework (https://www.boodooframework.com/).
- Published on npm as `haticons` (version 1.0.0) with TypeScript declarations (`index.d.ts`) and programmatic querying API.

## Installation Quick Links
- npm: `npm install haticons`
- Full Bundle CDN: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/haticons@1.0.0/dist/css/haticons.min.css`
- Core CSS: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/haticons@1.0.0/dist/css/core.min.css`
- Category CDN pattern: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/haticons@1.0.0/dist/css/categories/{category}.min.css`

## HTML Usage Pattern
```html
<i class="hi-cart"></i>
<i class="hi-refresh hi-spin"></i>
<i class="hi-heart text-danger hi-2x"></i>
```

## JavaScript API Pattern
```javascript
import { icons, categories, getIcon, getByCategory } from 'haticons';

const cart = getIcon('hi-cart');
const commerceIcons = getByCategory('commerce');
```

## Categories Catalog
- `brands`: Tech stacks, social platforms, and developer services (257 icons)
- `interface`: Core UI controls, ratings, switches, menus (87 icons)
- `commerce`: Cards, carts, wallets, and payment gateways (17 icons)
- `editor`: Text alignment, lists, editing, tags, and markers (17 icons)
- `directional`: Arrows, chevrons, turns, next/previous (16 icons)
- `feedback`: Checks, alerts, warnings, and notifications (20 icons)
- `files`: Documents, folders, archives, and attachments (14 icons)
- `media`: Play, pause, volume, cameras, and multimedia (13 icons)
- `communication`: Messages, mail, chat bubbles, paper planes (11 icons)
- `devices`: Monitors, phones, networks, and appliances (10 icons)
- `users`: User profiles, avatars, roles, and contacts (9 icons)
- `navigation`: Maps, location pins, transport, vehicles (9 icons)
- `security`: Locks, unlocks, keys, and privacy symbols (8 icons)
- `time`: Clocks, calendars, alarms, and dates (6 icons)
